name: Produkte Kategorie
description: One row per product category, standalone (NOT a child table) — Produkte links to this via a Link field. Holds everything the /produkte/shop category-hub tile needs: the translated label, the tile image, and a translated alt text for that image (distinct from the label, unlike the current frontend which reuses the label as alt). Mirrors src/lib/seo/productCategories.js's CATEGORY_I18N map plus the categoryKey grouping in src/lib/shop/shopProducts.js, which can both be retired once the frontend fully trusts this doctype for every category.

fields.label: Category Key
fields.description: Raw key used in Produkte.kategories (minus the brand suffix), e.g. sofas, beds, dining tables, coffee tables. Lowercase, matches src/lib/seo/productCategories.js's deriveCategoryKey() output for a real product exactly.

fields.label: Tile Image
fields.description: The representative image shown on the /produkte/shop category-hub tile (ShopCategoryGrid). Falls back to the first real product's image, then a static fallback, when left blank.

fields.label: Image alt text (accessibility/SEO, distinct from the name above)
